set.body: Scope: inspect and execute current group module and first-level bridge through ordinary public APIs; independent OLS/WLS/DL calculations, adversarial scale/rank/failure tests, JVM and Scala.js suites, realistic timing and allocation measurements. Record bounded evidence and concrete native follow-ups before consumer admission. No broad estimator expansion is implied. Related native work: bd-01KX2CQZGWBQ3KKX7BWE28X3T2 and bd-01KX6G9BFJRERNFRWR17WT0YGN. Consumer: PLS Neuro standard second-level GLM requirement.
set.title: Audit existing group GLM numerical correctness quality and realistic performance
